info.title: BitHosting Control Plane API
info.description: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the BitHosting control plane. The spec is the source of truth: bhc-api CI fails when routes drift from this document in either direction. M0 covers authentication (customer + admin, TOTP) and admin settings. Errors follow RFC 9457 application/problem+json with a stable `code` member.

get.summary: Public catalog tree (active products, plans, addons)
get.description: Names are resolved to the request locale (Accept-Language, el default) and also returned in full under name_i18n. Prices use the Money shape. Plan config is whitelisted — provisioning internals never appear here.

200.description: Products with plans and prices, plus addons.

post.summary: Register a customer (creates the user, their account, owner membership)
Request a password reset link
Reset the password with an emailed token
Accept a team invite token
post.description: Fresh (claim-invite) users must supply name + password; existing users accept with the token alone. Does not establish a session.

post.summary: Customer login (step 1)

200.description: Either the session is established (two_factor_required=false, user present) or a TOTP challenge is pending (two_factor_required=true).

post.summary: Customer login (step 2 — TOTP code)

422.description: TOTP_INVALID (wrong/replayed code) or LOGIN_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED (no pending login / older than 5 minutes) or VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: Customer logout
Begin TOTP enrollment
Confirm TOTP enrollment with a live code

200.description: TOTP enabled; recovery codes issued (shown once — v1.3).

delete.summary: Disable TOTP (customers only — requires password + current code)

post.summary: Regenerate recovery codes (password + live TOTP; invalidates old set)

422.description: TOTP_INVALID or VALIDATION_FAILED (wrong password) or TOTP not enabled.

200.description: Accounts the current user belongs to, with their role.

put.summary: Update billing details / tax profile (owner, admin or billing role)
put.description: Saving a VAT number for an EU country triggers a VIES validation and recomputes tax_treatment (GR → gr_standard; EU + valid VIES → eu_reverse; EU without valid VIES → gr_standard; anything else → non_eu). When VIES is unreachable the profile still saves with vies_valid=null.

200.description: Updated account with recomputed tax fields.

post.summary: Validate an EU VAT number against VIES (cached with TTL)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 EU member state (GR maps to VIES EL).

200.description: VIES verdict (served from cache inside the TTL).

503.description: VIES_UNAVAILABLE — the EU service did not answer.

delete.summary: Remove a member (owner/admin; owners cannot be removed)

post.summary: Invite a person by email (owner/admin)
post.description: Creates a pending membership (accepted_at null) and emails a signed, TTL-bound token. Unknown emails get a claim-invite user (no password) that sets name+password on acceptance.

post.summary: Place an order (proforma issued immediately)
post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key header (stored 24h — spec §3.3): replays return the original response. Totals are computed server-side with the §7 tax resolution, including the v1.3 VIES fallback. Coupons validate server-side; the redemption is recorded against the order.

201.description: Order placed; proforma issued (gapless PF series).

422.description: VALIDATION_FAILED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED, or BILLING_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE (tax country missing).

post.summary: Cancel a pending order (voids the proforma, frees the coupon)
Create a payment session for a pending order
post.description: The single third-party call allowed inline (§3.1). Part A uses the fake gateway; Part B swaps Viva/Everypay behind the same contract.

200.description: Credit balance is consumed first (§7). If it fully covers the proforma the order settles immediately (status=paid, no session); otherwise a gateway session is returned for the remainder.

post.summary: Verify a payment from the gateway return redirect
post.description: Lost-webhook safety net: the gateway redirects the customer back with a transaction reference (Viva: the `t` query param). The transaction is verified against the gateway API and settled from that truth. Idempotent — replays and races with the webhook are harmless.

get.description: Some gateways (Viva) verify a webhook URL with a GET request that must echo a provider-issued verification key. Responds only when {provider} is the active gateway and its driver supports the handshake; 404 otherwise. The response shape follows the provider's expectation (Viva: `{"Key": "..."}`).

200.description: Verification key for the provider's handshake.

post.summary: Gateway payment callback (server-to-server)
post.description: Signature-verified per provider driver; deduplicated on the provider event id (§15.4). Always answers 200 for verified events — including replays — so gateways stop retrying.

schema.description: Provider-specific payload; normalized by the driver.

get.summary: List the services of an account (member-gated)
Service detail with the provisioning timeline

200.description: The service (timeline mirrors the account channel events).

post.summary: Issue a one-time control-panel SSO link (short TTL, audited)
post.description: Target `panel` only in v1 (spec §5 ssoUrl); `wp_admin` and `console` arrive with M7. Each issuance is audit-logged against the actor.

409.description: Service is not in a state that can be entered (SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVE).

post.summary: Change the service plan — immediate upgrade or scheduled downgrade

200.description: Upgrade: the service already on the new plan (snapshot rewritten, next_due rolled). Downgrade: the service carrying pending_plan_change.

402.description: Payment failed or no usable method — ZERO state change (PAYMENT_FAILED).

409.description: Not active (SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVE — explicit for suspended/pending/ terminated alike), node cannot fit the new plan (NO_CAPACITY — clean block, zero state change) or plan incompatible (PLAN_NOT_COMPATIBLE).

get.summary: Deterministic proration preview (the engine's numbers, pre-commit)

200.description: The exact amounts the change would produce today.

post.summary: Cancel a scheduled downgrade (until the J-7 invoice is issued)

200.description: Pending change cleared; the renewal bills the old plan.

409.description: Nothing pending (NO_PENDING_PLAN_CHANGE), locked past J-7 (PLAN_CHANGE_LOCKED) or not active (SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVE).

post.summary: Mid-cycle addon purchase — prorated remainder invoiced now

201.description: Addon active on the service; the snapshot records the FULL cycle price (renewals bill that, v1.4).

409.description: Not active (SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVE), already present (ADDON_ALREADY_PRESENT), incompatible (PLAN_NOT_COMPATIBLE) or no free dedicated IP (NO_CAPACITY).

201.description: The record as Cloudflare stored it; cache resynced. `warning` appears when an informed proxied choice lands outside the cert coverage on a strict zone (created anyway — never blocked).

422.description: Input validation (VALIDATION_FAILED) or the provider's own validator mirrored verbatim (DNS_PROVIDER_REJECTED).

put.summary: Update a record (managed records demand confirm=true)

confirm.description: Required true when touching a managed record.

200.description: The updated record; cache resynced. `warning` as on create.

409.description: Managed record without confirm (MANAGED_RECORD_CONFIRM_REQUIRED), NS record (NS_RECORD_IMMUTABLE — zone authority is not a record) or zone not ready (ZONE_NOT_READY).

422.description: Input validation (VALIDATION_FAILED) or the provider's own validator mirrored verbatim (DNS_PROVIDER_REJECTED — the detail carries the provider reason).

delete.summary: Delete a record (managed records demand confirm=true)

409.description: Managed record without confirm (MANAGED_RECORD_CONFIRM_REQUIRED) or NS record (NS_RECORD_IMMUTABLE).

cookieAuth.name: bhc_session
cookieAuth.description: Sanctum SPA session cookie. Obtain via GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie (out of contract scope) and send the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on mutating requests.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a stable machine-readable `code`.

Money.description: Spec §3.3 — integer minor units, EUR only in v1.

secret.description: Base32 TOTP secret (shown once; SPA renders the QR).

remember.description: Ignored on the admin surface (admins get no remember-me).

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code — or, on the login challenge, a one-time recovery code (v1.3). Recovery codes are consumed on use.

recovery_codes.description: One-time codes, shown exactly once — store them safely.

DocumentRef.description: Lightweight reference to a billing document (proforma/invoice).

vies_fallback_applied.description: v1.3 — Greek VAT charged because VIES was unavailable/unconfirmed.

Service.description: Customer view — external refs and node internals never leak.

timeline.description: Present on show — latest provisioning task steps.

pending_plan_change.description: Scheduled downgrade (M3.5) — applied at renewal, quota-guarded at J-7 and at application, cancellable until the J-7 invoice issues.

PlanChangePreview.description: The proration engine's deterministic numbers (§7 v1.9 rounding — retained floors, credit = snapshot − retained, sums close to the cent).

charge.description: Full new-cycle price (immediate paths) or the new renewal price (downgrade).

net_due_now.description: The card's exact share after the §7 balance-first split: gross minus what the wallet (balance + fresh credit) absorbs. 0 for downgrades and when the wallet covers everything.

status.description: attention_needed = zone up but managed records skipped over conflicts.

conflicts.description: Managed records NOT applied because a pre-existing customer record occupies the same name/type — never overwritten (§8 guardrail).

Domain.description: Customer view of a domain and its managed zone (§8). Zone status attention_needed means managed records were skipped over conflicts with pre-existing customer records — surfaced here, never silently half-applied.

PropagationStatus.description: Live DoH probe verdict. `unknown` = the resolver could not answer — the probe degrades, it never 5xxs (§3.1 sanctioned-exception terms).

type.description: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA…

managed.description: Carries the bhc managed tag — guarded in the editor.

AdminServer.description: plesk_api_key is write-only and never appears here.

health.description: Last healthcheck snapshot (reachable, disk_pct, load, checked_at).

plesk_api_key.description: Stored encrypted; omit on update to keep the current key.

missing.description: Active plan keys with no matching service plan on the node.

timeline.description: Append-only step log (§6.2), broadcast on account.{uuid}.

Forbidden.description: Denied (code FORBIDDEN) — or ADMIN_TOTP_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED when an unenrolled admin touches a gated admin route.

ValidationFailed.description: Validation failed (code VALIDATION_FAILED) — also used for bad credentials (errors.email). Domain TOTP failures use codes TOTP_INVALID or LOGIN_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED with the plain Problem shape.
